body:
![The mythbound logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a36b8c368f9b821c26d45eeec91ee42e5ae30704.png)    
MythBound is a high-fantasy RPG Minecraft modpack built for exploration, progression, and immersive combat. Dive into a world filled with ancient ruins, dangerous dungeons, mythical creatures, powerful magic systems, and deep RPG progression that transforms vanilla Minecraft into an adventure-driven experience.

From massive world generation overhauls to skill-based combat and spellcasting, MythBound focuses on making every journey feel meaningful. Discover new biomes, fight enhanced bosses, collect powerful artifacts, and build your character through RPG classes, abilities, and equipment systems.

This pack is designed to feel alive — with improved animations, immersive sound design, dynamic structures, and a heavily enhanced survival experience.

Features
RPG class and skill systems with deep progression
Overhauled world generation with new biomes and structures
Enhanced combat, spells, and abilities
Immersive animations, audio, and visual improvements
Exploration-focused gameplay with dungeons and bosses
Quality-of-life improvements and performance optimizations
Recommended Settings
8–10GB RAM recommended
Use Sodium + Iris shaders for best visuals
Best experienced with sound and shaders enabled
Gameplay Style
Exploration RPG
Survival progression
Dungeon crawling
Magic + fantasy combat
